intent: Carry the morning lesson about evidence and actual state into an afternoon work-method change, then show whether the revised control becomes repeatable field behavior.

stages.purpose: establish that a written statement must match the evidence and actual state
contrast the still-valid morning TBM with an afternoon task condition that has changed
observe whether the response leaves a paper gap, chills reporting, or creates a repeatable changed-work control

presentation_rules: Do not describe the morning TBM as wrong; distinguish its original conditions from the changed afternoon conditions.
Show operational tradeoffs for every response without labeling a route correct or incorrect.
When tbm_gap_result is written, update the same 13:56 panel from verification focus to field verdict.
